_readme: PRODUCTS — HOW TO ADD OR EDIT A PRODUCT
Each entry in 'products' becomes a card on the Products page (/products) and a detail page at /products/<id>.
Required fields: id (unique), name, category, description (short card summary), price (e.g. 'KSh 1,250'),
availability (e.g. 'In Stock'), featured (true = 'Featured' badge + homepage section), image, alt (image description).
Optional fields (shown on the product's detail page): longDescription (fuller intro), highlights ('Why choose'
bullets), nutritionNote + nutrition (per-100g values), benefits (bullet list), usage (how-to-use bullets),
caution (safety note shown in a highlighted box).
IMAGES: to use a local image, save your photo in public/assets/images/products/ (e.g.
Until the image file is added, a placeholder is shown automatically.
CATEGORIES: the 'categories' array below is the official list of product categories, shown in this order
on the Products page (empty categories display a 'Coming soon' state) and in the site footer.
When adding a product, set its category to one of these exact names.
NOTE: the live catalogue is stored in the database and managed from the admin dashboard (/admin/products).
This file is only used as seed data by 'npm run db:seed' (existing rows are never overwritten).

products.name: Organic Almonds
products.description: Naturally pure almonds rich in plant protein, healthy fats, fibre, vitamin E, and essential minerals. A crunchy, wholesome snack for everyday nutrition.
products.alt: Organic almonds in a wooden bowl on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Almonds are healthy nuts with numerous benefits — high in protein, healthy fats, fibre, vitamins, and minerals. They provide calories and vitamins for their antioxidant benefits, plus magnesium for healthy bodily function and many other great nutrients that promote your health.
highlights: Naturally Pure — no artificial colours, flavours, or preservatives added.
Rich in Protein & Healthy Fats — everyday nutrition with protein and good fats your body absorbs naturally.
Naturally Nutrient-Dense — an excellent source of dietary fibre and essential minerals, including vitamin E.
Naturally Crunchy & Delicious — nice and crunchy, with a good nutty flavour in every munch.
Hygienically Packed — quality packed to seal in freshness, flavour, and crunchiness.
products.nutritionNote: Per 100g, almonds supply the following nutritional values:
benefits: Rich in plant-based protein.
Rich in monounsaturated fats that support good heart health.
Rich in vitamin E to protect against cell damage and support skin health.
Provides dietary fibre, which aids good digestion.
Good source of magnesium, calcium, phosphorus, and B vitamins.

products.name: Roasted Cashew Nuts
products.description: Oven-roasted cashews with a touch of salt — a deliciously crunchy, protein-rich snack with healthy fats and essential minerals. Best enjoyed in moderation.
products.alt: Roasted salted cashew nuts in a wooden bowl on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Cashews are a good source of healthy dietary fats, which are vital for our body to absorb fat-soluble vitamins and produce fatty acids that are crucial for brain development and blood clotting.
highlights: Naturally Delicious — a delicious, rich, crunchy bite, roasted with a touch of salt.
Protein Rich — a natural way to get protein into your diet every day.
Healthy Fats — healthy fats as a natural constituent of the nut.
Expertly Roasted — oven-roasted for a perfectly crisp and savoury flavour.
Hygienically Packed — sealed to keep out external elements and lock in quality and freshness.
Versatile Snack — delicious to nibble on, bake with, and share around.
Trusted Quality — specially prepared to ensure a fresh and delicious taste.
benefits: A good source of protein and unsaturated fat.
Heart health — heart-healthy fats that may help balance cholesterol levels, supporting cardiovascular health.
Antioxidant protection — a source of antioxidants, including polyphenols, that help the body deal with oxidative stress.
Brain health — protein, essential fats, vitamins, and minerals working together to support memory and focus.
Bone strength — magnesium, phosphorus, copper, and zinc to support bone density.
Good for the eyes — contains lutein and zeaxanthin, which help protect the eyes and support healthy eyesight.
A source of dietary fibre, and contains oleic and palmitic acids.
usage: Snacking — enjoy straight from the pack.
Cooking — blend into cashew nut butter for cooking purposes.
Baking — incorporate into your cakes and breads to boost the nutritional profile.
Smoothies — add to your smoothies for nutritional richness.
products.caution: NB: Roasted cashew nuts are best eaten in moderation.

products.name: Cold-Pressed Virgin Coconut Oil
products.description: The multi-purpose miracle oil — pressed from fresh, mature Kenyan coconuts (not dried copra) and cold-pressed below 40°C. No heat, no chemicals, no bleaching. Rich in MCTs and lauric acid for cooking, hair, skin, baby care and oil pulling. One oil, 20 uses.
products.alt: Glass jar of white virgin coconut oil with a fresh cracked coconut on a natural surface in bright light
products.longDescription: Pressed from fresh, mature Kenyan coconuts — not dried copra. Our cold-pressed virgin method means no heat, no chemicals, no bleaching. Just pure white oil that smells like fresh coconut and melts the moment it touches your skin. It solidifies when cool (white butter) and turns liquid when warm (clear oil) — both states are 100% normal and pure; that melting behaviour is proof it is virgin, not refined. Unlike other oils that need to be broken down in the liver, the MCTs in coconut oil go straight to your cells for quick energy — and to your skin and hair for instant absorption. On skin and hair, its small molecular structure penetrates deep into the hair shaft and skin barrier rather than just sitting on top. From Coast to Skin. One oil, for the whole family.
highlights: Rich in Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCTs) — especially Lauric Acid (50%+) — the same immune-supporting fat found in breast milk.
Naturally antibacterial, antifungal and antiviral — lauric acid fights the fungus that causes dandruff and supports the body's natural defences.
Plus Vitamin E, Vitamin K and natural antioxidants that help with fine lines and keep skin supple.
Kenya's #1 hair oil — penetrates inside the hair shaft to stop protein loss, reducing breakage, split ends and dryness.
A natural lotion for brown skin — instant soft, glowing skin with a beautiful non-greasy sheen, and a gentle, chemical-free baby massage oil.
Edible-grade — great for frying, baking, chapati, mandazi, bulletproof coffee and Ayurvedic oil pulling.
Made from fresh, mature coconuts from coastal Kenya — cold-pressed below 40°C in small batches; never refined, bleached or deodorized. One oil, 20 uses.
products.nutritionNote: What's inside and how it works:
nutrition: Medium Chain Triglycerides (MCTs) — skip the liver and go straight to your cells for quick, clean energy; on skin and hair they absorb instantly instead of sitting on top.
Lauric Acid (50%+) — naturally antibacterial, antifungal and antiviral; on the scalp it fights the fungus behind dandruff and itching.
Vitamin E + natural antioxidants — support anti-aging, supple skin and everyday cellular protection.
Small molecular structure — penetrates deep into the hair shaft and skin barrier, which is why it repairs rather than just coats.
benefits: Deep hair moisturizer — penetrates inside the hair shaft to stop protein loss; reduces breakage, split ends and dryness.
Hair growth & thickness — massaging into the scalp improves circulation and keeps follicles healthy.
Dandruff & itchy scalp — lauric acid fights the fungus that causes dandruff and itching.
Natural heat protectant & detangler — smooths the cuticle, makes combing easy and adds real shine; keeps braids soft and scalps moisturized.
Daily body butter — instant soft, glowing skin for dry elbows, knees, feet and ashy skin.
Soothes irritation — calms rashes, sunburn, insect bites and eczema-prone skin.
Anti-aging — Vitamin E and antioxidants help with fine lines and keep skin supple.
Makeup remover — melts makeup and waterproof mascara gently, even around the eyes.
After shave — prevents bumps and soothes shaved legs, underarms and beard.
Baby care — a gentle, chemical-free massage oil for baby's skin and cradle cap, plus a protective diaper balm.
Cracked heels & lips — heals dry lips, cracked heels and cuticles overnight.
Oil pulling — a teaspoon swished for 5-10 minutes supports fresh breath, whiter teeth and gum health (Ayurvedic practice).
Cooking — a high-smoke-point virgin oil for frying, baking and bulletproof coffee; 1-2 tablespoons a day gives quick, clean MCT energy.
usage: As scalp oil — melt a small amount between palms, massage into the scalp 3x a week, leave for 2 hours or overnight, then wash. For growth, mix with Olivoria Rosemary & Castor Oil.
As hair mask — apply generously from root to tip on dry hair, cover with a cap for 1 hour, then shampoo. Repairs bleached and heat-damaged hair.
As daily sealer — a tiny amount on the ends to seal in moisture and stop breakage.
As lotion — use on damp skin right after a shower to lock in moisture best; a little goes a long way.
As face oil (dry skin only) — a pea-sized amount at night. If you are acne-prone or oily, use on the body, not the face, or mix with jojoba.
For lips & heels — apply a thick layer before sleep.
Oil pulling — on an empty stomach, 1 teaspoon, swish gently (don't gargle) for 5-10 minutes, spit into the trash (not the sink), then rinse.
For cooking — use 1:1 to replace vegetable oil; great for chapati, mandazi, frying and bulletproof coffee.
products.caution: 100% natural, but do a patch test first. If you are very acne-prone, avoid heavy use on the face — it can clog pores for some. For cooking, 1-2 tablespoons a day is enough. Storage: keeps 2 years — it will solidify below 24°C and melt above; both states are 100% pure. Keep the lid tight; no need to refrigerate. Real virgin coconut oil smells and tastes like fresh coconut, turns solid white when cold and clear when warm, and melts instantly on the skin.

products.name: Eucalyptus Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Eucalyptus globulus leaves — a distinct, invigorating aroma traditionally used to support clear breathing, relaxation, and everyday wellbeing.
products.alt: Bottle of eucalyptus essential oil with fresh eucalyptus leaves on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Eucalyptus essential oil is derived from the leaves of the Eucalyptus globulus tree through a steam distillation process. Its concentration and richness give it a distinct aroma suitable for many uses — from aromatherapy and decongestion to traditional wellness and personal care. Altogether, its warming topical comfort, respiratory support, and natural insect-repelling benefit make it a versatile and valuable natural remedy for daily wellbeing.
nutrition: Rich in 1,8-cineole (eucalyptol) — a versatile phytochemical with a wide range of traditional applications.
benefits: Respiratory health — traditionally used to ease congestion when the airways feel compromised; 1,8-cineole helps break down mucus, easing colds and coughs.
Anti-inflammatory — the compounds in eucalyptus oil may ease aches associated with conditions like rheumatoid arthritis and general muscle strain when applied topically.
Antimicrobial — exhibits activity against bacteria and viruses and helps suppress biofilm formation; commonly used in natural cleaning and topical products.
Mental clarity & relaxation — the invigorating scent is used in aromatherapy to create a refreshing environment, promote relaxation, and increase focus and mental freshness.
Oral health — often appears in toothpaste and mouthwash because it combats bacteria, helping reduce bad breath and supporting a fresher, cleaner mouth.
Natural insect repellent — its scent helps keep mosquitoes, flies, and wasps away, making it especially useful in the summer months.
usage: Inhalation — add a few drops to hot water or a tissue to help clear the airways.
Aromatherapy — use up to 10 drops in a diffuser for continuous support throughout the day.
Massage therapy — mix with a carrier oil and massage into the chest, back, or sore muscles.
Bath soak — add a few drops to warm bath water for relaxation and comfort.
Topical application — dilute with a carrier oil (such as coconut or jojoba) before applying to the chest, throat, or affected areas for muscle or joint relief.
Oral use — one to two drops in honey or a carrier oil, only when the oil is clearly indicated as safe for oral use.

products.name: Peppermint Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Mentha × piperita leaves and flowering tops — high menthol content gives an intense cooling sensation and wide versatility for everyday wellness.
products.alt: Bottle of peppermint essential oil with fresh peppermint leaves on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Peppermint essential oil is derived from the leaves and flowering tops of Mentha × piperita through a steam distillation process. It is known for its high menthol content, which gives it both its intense cooling sensation and its wide versatility.
nutrition: Rich in menthol and menthone, which provide the cooling sensation and fresh mint aroma.
benefits: Aromatherapy — the fresh menthol aroma helps create a sense of openness in the airways, making breathing feel more comfortable during seasonal congestion.
Digestive comfort — in a diluted massage blend, peppermint oil can feel soothing on the stomach during periods of digestive sluggishness, bloating, indigestion, or gas.
Mental freshness — traditionally used to enhance mental focus, memory, and alertness through diffusion or direct inhalation.
Tension relief — the cooling sensation, when diluted and applied to the temples or neck, can help relieve feelings of tightness and pressure.
usage: Aromatherapy inhalation — add a few drops to a diffuser to support focus and alertness, or inhale from a tissue or cotton pad for a quick sensory boost.
Steam inhalation — add a small amount to a bowl of warm water for a refreshing steam, often used during periods of congestion.
Topical application — dilute with a carrier oil (such as coconut or olive) and apply to relieve muscle discomfort, headaches, or itching. Perform a patch test before full application.
Nausea relief — inhalation or aromatherapy using peppermint oil has been used to reduce nausea and ease vomiting, including after surgery or chemotherapy.
Massage blends — diluted with a carrier oil, massage into the abdomen, neck, shoulders, or legs to soothe tense, tired areas after long days or physical activity.
Bathing — a few drops diluted in a carrier oil or bath base create an invigorating soak.
products.caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes, lips, mucous membranes, and broken skin. Always dilute with a carrier oil before applying to the skin — never use undiluted on the skin.

products.name: Lemongrass Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Cymbopogon citratus leaves and stalks — a powerful citrus aroma traditionally used in aromatherapy to relieve stress and anxiety, with digestive and household uses.
products.alt: Bottle of lemongrass essential oil with fresh lemongrass stalks on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Lemongrass essential oil is derived from the leaves and stalks of Cymbopogon citratus through a steam distillation method of extraction. It has a powerful citrus scent, recommended for aromatherapy that may help relieve stress and anxiety, and it is also traditionally used for digestive comfort. From its therapeutic properties to its applications in beauty and household cleaning, it offers a natural, effective solution for many everyday needs.
nutrition: Rich in citral, which provides the strong lemon scent, along with geraniol and limonene.
benefits: Antibacterial — traditionally used as a natural remedy that may help heal wounds and help prevent infection, including against bacteria that cause skin and intestinal infections.
Mental health — the calming, mild smell of lemongrass oil is known in aromatherapy to help relieve anxiety and irritability.
Digestive health — used as a traditional remedy for a number of digestive concerns, ranging from stomachaches to gastric ulcers.
Natural deodorizer and cleaner — use as a natural, safe air freshener or deodorizer around the home.
Natural bug repellent — its high citral and geraniol content helps repel bugs such as mosquitoes and ants.
Antifungal — the citral and limonene content can kill or stifle the growth of fungi, helping you avoid infections such as ringworm and athlete's foot.
usage: Aromatherapy — diffuse throughout your home using an oil diffuser or vaporizer.
Steam inhalation — add a couple of drops to a bowl of hot water, cover your head with a towel, close your eyes, and breathe in gently.
Massage therapy — dilute in a carrier oil like jojoba or sweet almond; its crisp aroma provides a spa-like touch that feels both refreshing and soothing.
Room sprays — mix with distilled water and witch hazel for an easy way to freshen linens, fabrics, and the air.

products.name: Oregano Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Origanum vulgare leaves — one of the most powerful antioxidant essential oils, rich in carvacrol and thymol, traditionally used to support immunity and digestion.
products.alt: Bottle of oregano essential oil with fresh oregano leaves on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Oregano essential oil is derived from the leaves of Origanum vulgare through a steam distillation process. It is one of the most powerful and versatile antioxidant essential oils — traditionally used to stimulate the immune and digestive systems and strengthen the body's natural energy. From its antimicrobial and antifungal strength to skin, hair, and immune support, it offers a spectrum of wellness benefits.
nutrition: Rich in carvacrol — the main active compound in oregano oil.
Rich in thymol — which may help protect against toxins and fight fungal infections.
benefits: Aromatherapy — used in diffusers to refresh the air (typically in short bursts of 5–10 minutes in well-ventilated spaces).
Digestive support — traditionally used as part of herbal protocols for small intestinal bacterial overgrowth (SIBO) and other digestive concerns such as harmful microbes and digestive discomfort.
Sore throat relief — traditionally used for quick relief against sore throat.
Antimicrobial — traditionally used against drug-resistant bacteria and yeast.
Immune support — supports immunity due to its high antioxidant activity.
Antifungal — studies indicate oregano oil can disrupt fungal cells (such as candida), offering a natural complementary approach to traditional antifungal treatments.
usage: Internally (diluted) — add one to two drops to a carrier oil or water for immune and digestive support.
Topically — mix with a carrier oil for skin applications.
Aromatherapy — inhale for respiratory relief.

products.name: Wintergreen Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Gaultheria procumbens leaves — a sweet, minty aroma naturally rich in methyl salicylate, traditionally used in diluted massage blends for warming relief of tired muscles and joints.
products.alt: Bottle of wintergreen essential oil with fresh wintergreen leaves on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Wintergreen essential oil is derived from the leaves of Gaultheria procumbens through a steam distillation process. It is naturally rich in methyl salicylate — the plant-derived compound that gives the oil its sweet, minty aroma and its traditional warming, soothing reputation. From massage blends for tired muscles and joints to aromatherapy for a refreshing, grounding atmosphere, it is a valued part of the natural wellness cabinet.
nutrition: Rich in methyl salicylate — the characteristic active compound of wintergreen oil.
benefits: Warming muscle relief — traditionally used in diluted massage blends to soothe tired, overworked muscles and joints after physical activity.
Tension relief — its cooling-warming sensation, when well diluted and applied to the temples or neck, can help ease feelings of tightness and pressure.
Comforting aroma — the sweet, minty scent is used in aromatherapy to create a calming, grounded environment.
Natural household freshener — commonly added to natural cleaning blends for a crisp, clean scent.
usage: Massage therapy — dilute with a carrier oil and massage into tired muscles and joints for a warming, soothing effect.
Aromatherapy — diffuse for a short time to enjoy its sweet, refreshing aroma.
Bath soak — add a few drops to a carrier oil before mixing into warm bath water for a comforting soak.
Topical application — always dilute with a carrier oil before applying to the skin. Perform a patch test before full application.
products.caution: For external use only. Wintergreen oil is naturally high in methyl salicylate and must always be well diluted before skin contact. Keep away from children, and avoid use if pregnant, nursing, or taking blood-thinning medication. Never ingest.

products.name: Lavender Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Lavandula angustifolia flowers — a gentle, floral aroma traditionally cherished for relaxation, restful sleep, and everyday skin soothing. One of the most versatile essential oils.
products.alt: Bottle of lavender essential oil with fresh lavender flowers on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Lavender essential oil is derived from the flowers of Lavandula angustifolia through a steam distillation process. Prized for centuries for its gentle, floral aroma, it is often described as the most versatile of all essential oils — equally at home in aromatherapy for relaxation and restful sleep, in diluted skin care for everyday soothing, and in massage blends for unwinding at the end of a long day.
nutrition: Rich in linalool and linalyl acetate — the compounds behind its gentle, floral aroma and calming reputation.
benefits: Relaxation & restful sleep — widely used in aromatherapy to calm the mind, ease feelings of stress, and support a peaceful night's rest.
Everyday skin soothing — when well diluted, traditionally applied to soothe minor skin irritation, insect bites, and small blemishes.
Tension relief — the soothing aroma helps ease headaches and feelings of tightness when massaged (diluted) into the temples and neck.
Gentle on most skin types — one of the few essential oils traditionally tolerated in careful dilution by sensitive skin.
usage: Aromatherapy — diffuse in the evening or add a drop to your pillow to unwind and prepare for restful sleep.
Topical application — dilute with a carrier oil and apply to the temples, neck, or irritated skin as needed. Perform a patch test before full application.
Bath soak — mix a few drops into a carrier oil or bath base and add to warm water for a calming soak.
Massage therapy — blend with a carrier oil for a relaxing full-body or shoulder massage.
products.caution: For external use only. Always dilute with a carrier oil before applying to the skin. Avoid contact with eyes and broken skin.

products.name: Clove Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Syzygium aromaticum buds — a warm, spicy aroma rich in eugenol, traditionally used for dental comfort, immune support, and as a hardworking natural antimicrobial.
products.alt: Bottle of clove essential oil with whole cloves on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Clove essential oil is derived from the dried flower buds of Syzygium aromaticum through a steam distillation process. Its warm, spicy aroma comes from its high eugenol content — a compound that has made clove oil a staple of traditional wellness practice for centuries, from dental comfort and seasonal immune support to natural home care and insect deterrence.
nutrition: Rich in eugenol — the dominant active compound behind clove oil's warm aroma and traditional uses.
benefits: Dental comfort — traditionally applied (well diluted) to soothe toothache and gum discomfort; a classic ingredient in natural oral care.
Powerful antimicrobial — traditionally used against bacteria and fungi in natural home cleaning and personal care.
Immune support — its high antioxidant activity makes it a favourite in seasonal wellness routines.
Digestive comfort — a traditional remedy for occasional bloating and digestive sluggishness when used appropriately.
Natural insect repellent — its warm, spicy scent helps deter insects around the home.
usage: Oral comfort — dab a single diluted drop onto the affected gum or tooth area using a cotton swab; never apply undiluted.
Aromatherapy — diffuse in short bursts for a warm, grounding atmosphere.
Topical application — dilute with a carrier oil and apply to affected areas; perform a patch test first.
Home care — add a few drops to natural cleaning blends for its antimicrobial power and warm scent.
products.caution: For external use only. Clove oil is very concentrated and can irritate skin and mucous membranes — always dilute well and keep away from children. Avoid use if pregnant or nursing without professional guidance.

products.name: Cinnamon Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from Cinnamomum verum bark — a sweet, warming spice aroma traditionally used to energise the mind, support digestion, and freshen the home naturally.
products.alt: Bottle of cinnamon essential oil with cinnamon sticks on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Cinnamon essential oil is derived from the bark of Cinnamomum verum through a steam distillation process. Its sweet, warming aroma — driven by its natural cinnamaldehyde content — has made it a treasured spice and wellness ally for centuries. From energising aromatherapy and digestive comfort to natural home freshening and seasonal immune support, it brings warmth to any natural wellness routine.
nutrition: Rich in cinnamaldehyde — the compound responsible for its sweet, warming aroma and traditional benefits.
benefits: Mental invigoration — its warm, spicy scent is used in aromatherapy to energise the mind and combat feelings of fatigue.
Digestive comfort — a traditional remedy for slow digestion, bloating, and queasiness.
Antimicrobial — traditionally used against bacteria and fungi in natural home care and cleaning blends.
Seasonal immune support — a favourite in diffuser blends during the cold season.
Natural home freshener — a few drops impart a warm, welcoming scent to any room.
usage: Aromatherapy — diffuse in short bursts for a warm, energising atmosphere.
Topical application — always dilute heavily with a carrier oil before applying to the skin; perform a patch test first.
Home care — add to natural cleaning blends or a bowl of warm water for a warm, spicy home scent.
Massage therapy — blend sparingly with a carrier oil for an invigorating warming massage.
products.caution: For external use only. Cinnamon bark oil is a 'hot' oil and can irritate skin and mucous membranes — always dilute heavily and avoid contact with eyes and sensitive areas. Not recommended for young children.

products.name: Frankincense Essential Oil
products.description: Steam-distilled from sun-dried Boswellia resin tears - a warm, woody, spicy, slightly citrusy aroma that is both grounding and uplifting. Rich in alpha-pinene and boswellic acids, it works on three levels: skin, mind and body.
products.alt: Bottle of frankincense essential oil with frankincense resin tears on a natural surface
products.longDescription: Our Frankincense essential oil is steam-distilled from the sun-dried resin tears of the Boswellia tree, giving it a warm, woody, spicy, slightly citrusy aroma that is both grounding and uplifting. Frankincense is rich in alpha-pinene and boswellic acids - natural compounds that work on three levels. For the skin, it is astringent and regenerative: it helps tighten skin tissue, reduce the appearance of fine lines, and supports wound healing by speeding up skin cell turnover. For the mind, the aroma directly stimulates the limbic system - your emotional brain - lowering cortisol, slowing over-breathing, and creating a feeling of calm, focus and spiritual grounding; that is why it has been used for centuries for meditation and anxiety. For the body, boswellic acids are known to support a healthy inflammatory response, helping soothe joints, muscles and irritated airways.
highlights: Wild-Harvested & 100% Pure - steam-distilled straight from the resin tears with no fillers and no fragrance.
Batch-Tested for Purity - we test every batch; what you smell is straight from the resin tear.
Skin, Mind & Body in One Oil - astringent and regenerative for the skin, grounding for the mind, and soothing for joints and muscles.
A Classic Meditation Oil - used for centuries to clear mental fog, deepen breathing and support prayer and meditation.
nutrition: Botanical name: Boswellia carterii / sacra / serrata
Scent: Deep, resinous, warm wood with lemon-pepper top notes
Rich in alpha-pinene and boswellic acids - natural compounds acting on skin, mind and body
benefits: Anti-aging - helps reduce the appearance of wrinkles, fine lines and sagging by toning and lifting.
Scar & blemish support - fades the appearance of scars, stretch marks and dark spots.
Natural glow - controls oily skin, tightens pores and promotes an even tone.
Deep calm & anti-anxiety - one of the best oils for stress, racing thoughts and panic; instantly grounding.
Meditation & focus - clears mental fog, improves focus and deepens breathing for prayer and meditation.
Sleep support - helps quiet the mind for deeper, more restful sleep.
Immune support - traditionally diffused during the cold season to purify the air and support immune defence.
Respiratory support - opens airways, loosens mucus and eases chest tightness when inhaled.
Joint & muscle soothing - warming anti-inflammatory relief when massaged onto stiff joints, back pain and sore muscles.
Hormonal balance - traditionally used to support women's cycle comfort and mood during PMS and menopause.
usage: Diffusion (calm, focus, air purifying) - add 4-6 drops to a diffuser with water. Perfect for morning meditation, work stress, prayer, or evening wind-down. Blend with lavender for sleep or orange for uplifting.
Topical for the face - 2 drops of Frankincense in 1 teaspoon of jojoba or rosehip oil; dab on fine lines, scars and under the eyes at night. Always dilute - never use neat on skin.
Topical for body & joints - 5-6 drops in 1 tablespoon of carrier oil (coconut, sweet almond or castor); massage onto sore knees, back or stiff neck.
For stretch marks & scars - mix with Olivoria Shea Butter.

Inhalation (stress & breathing) - add 2 drops to a bowl of hot water, cover your head with a towel and inhale for 2 minutes; or put 1 drop on your palms, rub, cup over your nose and breathe deeply three times.
Bath - mix 5 drops with 1 tablespoon of carrier oil first, then add to a warm bath for full-body relaxation.
Natural home uses - add 3 drops to your floor cleaner, 2 drops to unscented lotion for a natural perfume, or blend with myrrh for other therapeutic management.
products.caution: External use only. Do not ingest unless under clinical aromatherapist supervision. Always dilute - it can cause skin irritation if undiluted. Avoid during the first trimester of pregnancy - consult a healthcare professional. Keep away from eyes and mucous membranes, and out of reach of children. Do a patch test first. If you have epilepsy or asthma, or are on blood thinners, consult your doctor. Use 100% pure Boswellia oil only - many cheap versions are diluted with chemicals.

products.name: Oral Gut Cleanser
products.description: A classical 7-in-1 herbal cleanser and detox blend for the gastrointestinal system - Senna, Psyllium Husk, Flaxseeds, Bentonite Clay, Activated Charcoal, Ginger and White Oak Bark working together to relieve constipation from five angles at once: stimulating, bulking, lubricating, binding toxins, and toning the bowel.
products.alt: Jar of herbal gut cleanser powder with senna leaves, psyllium husk and flaxseeds on a natural surface
products.longDescription: This is a classical herbal cleanser and detox blend for the gastrointestinal system - it works to relieve constipation by attacking it from five different angles at once: stimulating, bulking, lubricating, binding toxins, and toning the bowel. Senna pushes, Psyllium and Flax bulk and soften, Flax lubricates, Bentonite Clay and Activated Charcoal clean up gas and debris, Ginger calms cramps and nausea, and White Oak Bark tones and protects. It is a complete colon reset in one glass - formulated so you go comfortably, completely, and cleanly, then your gut is restored. Most laxatives only force you to go; Olivoria helps you go comfortably, completely, and cleanly - then restores your gut.
highlights: It Doesn't Just Push - It Softens, Lubricates & Cleans - Senna gently pushes, while Psyllium and Flaxseed create soft, bulky, lubricated stool that slides out easily. No straining, no pellet stools.
No Cramping, No Nausea - Thanks to Ginger - organic Ginger Root relaxes intestinal spasms, calms nausea, and warms up sluggish digestion. Smooth, comfortable release - not emergency runs.

Debloats While It Cleanses - constipation traps gas and toxins. Our dual detox binders - Bentonite Clay and Activated Charcoal - sweep old waste from colon walls and soak up gas and bloat as they go. You feel lighter, flatter, and less gassy - not just emptied.

It Tones, Not Weakens, Your Bowel - stimulant laxatives can leave your bowel stretched and weak. White Oak Bark - rich in natural tannins - tightens, tones, and strengthens bowel tissue after cleansing, helping restore natural regularity and soothing straining.

100% Plant-Based, Nothing Fake - seven organic, ethically sourced herbs only: Senna, Psyllium Husk, Flaxseeds, Bentonite, Activated Charcoal, Ginger, and White Oak. No senna overdose, no artificial flavours, sugar, or preservatives. Vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, cruelty-free. Lab-tested for purity.

A Reset, Not A Dependency - formulated as a 7-14 day gentle colon reset, not a daily crutch. It is designed to break the cycle of constipation, cleanse buildup, and help your body remember how to go on its own - when combined with water and fibre.
products.nutritionNote: The 7-in-1 formula - how each herb works in the mix:
nutrition: Senna (The Stimulator) - the active laxative driver. Its sennosides irritate the lining of the colon just enough to trigger strong peristalsis - the wave-like muscle contractions that push stool forward. A stimulant laxative that forces the bowel to move; works in 6-12 hours.

Psyllium Husk (The Bulker) - a soluble fibre that is the backbone of the formula. It absorbs 10-20x its weight in water and swells into a soft, gelatinous bulk that stretches the colon wall - signalling your brain to have a bowel movement - and makes stool soft, large, and easy to pass instead of hard pellets.

Flaxseeds (The Lubricator + Softener) - fibre-rich with extra oil. Flax provides soluble fibre for more soft bulk, insoluble fibre, plus mucilage and omega-3 oil that coat and lubricate the intestinal lining, helping stool slide through and preventing the scraping and straining that senna alone can cause.

Bentonite Clay (The Sweeper / Detoxifier) - volcanic clay with a strong negative electrical charge. As it moves through, it acts like a sponge magnet - binding positively charged toxins, excess bacteria, and old waste debris stuck to the colon wall - and swells slightly to help sweep the colon. It also helps firm up overly loose stools that senna can cause.

Activated Charcoal (The Gas & Bloat Binder) - highly porous carbon with millions of tiny pores. It doesn't make you go, but it adsorbs gas, toxins, and byproducts of slow digestion that build up when you are constipated - reducing bloating, cramping, and foul-smelling gas, and helping prevent re-absorption of toxins.

White Oak Bark (The Toner / Astringent) - the balancing ingredient most blends forget. Rich in tannins, this astringent gently tightens and tones bowel tissue after it has been stretched and stimulated. Traditionally used to strengthen loose bowel tone, reduce minor inflammation, and soothe haemorrhoids from straining - preventing the 'dependency' feeling of weak bowels after stimulant use.
Ginger Root (The Calmer) - relaxes intestinal spasms, calms nausea and queasiness, and warms up sluggish digestion so the push isn't painful.

Vitex regulates the signal, Black Cohosh cools the heat, Wild Yam eases cramps, Lady's Mantle tones and firms, and Ginseng restores energy. Women's hormonal changes are not one problem - they are many at once: hot flashes, mood swings, cycle irregularity, cramps, fatigue, sleepless nights. One herb can't fix that. Changease was formulated as a complete 5-in-1 support system, not a quick fix.
highlights: It Balances The Signal, Not Just The Symptom - Chaste Tree (Vitex) works with your pituitary gland - your hormone control centre - to help your body produce a healthier estrogen-progesterone balance. This is key for PMS irritability, irregular cycles, and perimenopausal mood swings. It helps your body find its rhythm again.

Cools The Heat Without Added Hormones - Black Cohosh is traditionally used for perimenopause and menopause to help reduce the frequency of hot flashes, night sweats, and nighttime restlessness. It contains no estrogen itself, but helps support your brain's temperature regulation - so you can feel cooler, sleep deeper, and feel more like yourself.

Eases Cramps + Supports Uterine Tone - Wild Yam, known as 'colic root', helps relax uterine smooth muscle to ease monthly cramping and pelvic tension, while Lady's Mantle - Europe's 'women's protector' - is rich in natural tannins that gently tone and strengthen uterine tissue, traditionally used for heavy flow comfort and post-period recovery. Together they provide comfort during bleeding AND strength after.

Restores The Energy That Hormonal Shifts Steal - when hormones fluctuate, your adrenals have to work harder, leaving you tired, foggy and flat. Panax Ginseng, a true adaptogen, helps your body adapt to stress and supports natural energy, mental clarity, and resilience. So you don't just feel less hormonal - you feel more energetic and focused.

100% Women-Centered, Clean Formulation - five organic, traditionally-used herbs only: Wild Yam, Lady's Mantle, Chaste Tree Berry, Ginseng, and Black Cohosh. No synthetic hormones, no soy isoflavones, no artificial additives, no sugar. Vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, cruelty-free. Lab-tested for purity and potency. Made in Kenya, formulated for African women's real needs.
products.nutritionNote: The five cardinal herbs - how each one works:
nutrition: Chaste Tree Berry (Vitex agnus-castus) - The Master Regulator - the core of the blend. Vitex works on the pituitary gland in the brain - the control tower for hormones - helping balance the ratio of estrogen to progesterone by supporting healthy progesterone production. When progesterone is low (common in PMS, irregular cycles, and perimenopause), you get mood swings, breast tenderness, spotting, and heavy cramps. By helping the body release more luteinizing hormone (LH), Vitex helps your own cycle produce more balanced progesterone. Most women notice it helps with cycle regularity, PMS irritability, and cyclical breast discomfort over 2-3 cycles.

Black Cohosh - The Hot Flash & Night Sweat Soother - the most researched herb for perimenopause, traditionally used by Native American women. It does not contain estrogen, but it acts on serotonin and temperature regulation centres in the brain, helping reduce the frequency and intensity of hot flashes, night sweats, and feeling overheated, and helping with the sleep disturbance and mood swings that come with fluctuating estrogen in menopause. It works best when hormones are fluctuating and falling, not when they are stable.

Wild Yam - The Comfort & Cramp Support - contains diosgenin, and was traditionally called 'colic root'. Valued not because it turns into hormones in the body (it doesn't directly), but because it helps relax smooth muscle - including the uterus - easing uterine cramping, pelvic tension, and low back discomfort linked to PMS and periods, and providing a sense of hormonal nourishment.

Lady's Mantle (Alchemilla vulgaris) - The Uterine Toner - known as the 'woman's protector' in European herbalism. Rich in tannins, it is a strong astringent and uterine tonic that helps tone and tighten the uterine lining and surrounding tissue. Traditionally used for heavy periods, spotting between cycles, and to support uterine strength after periods - the restorative herb after bleeding.

Ginseng (Panax or Siberian) - The Energy & Mood Lifter - an adaptogen that helps your adrenal glands handle stress. During hormonal changes, your adrenals have to pick up some hormone work. Ginseng supports adrenal energy, mental clarity, resistance to fatigue, and stable mood - countering the brain fog, low motivation, and exhaustion of PMS and menopause, and traditionally supporting healthy libido.

Fewer hot flashes and night sweats.

More calm energy, better sleep, and clearer focus during perimenopause.

For perimenopause / menopause - Black Cohosh helps with heat and sleep, Vitex helps with mood swings from hormone fluctuations, Ginseng helps with energy dips, Lady's Mantle helps with tissue tone as estrogen declines.
usage: A support system, not a quick fix - give it 2-3 cycles; most women notice the difference over that time.

products.caution: Important safety information - consult your healthcare professional first if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, trying to conceive, or have a history of hormone-sensitive conditions (fibroids, endometriosis, breast/ovarian/uterine history); if you are on hormonal birth control, HRT, fertility treatments, or thyroid medication (Vitex and Black Cohosh can interact with hormone therapies); if you have liver conditions (Black Cohosh should be used cautiously); or if you take blood thinners or blood pressure medication (Ginseng can interact). usage: Face (morning & night) — cleanse, take 3-4 drops, warm between palms, and press into slightly damp face, neck and under-eyes.
For oily/acne skin — use 2 drops at night mixed with 1 drop of tea tree oil. For dry/dull skin — mix 3 drops Baobab + 2 drops Rosehip for an instant glow.
Under makeup — use as a primer; 2 drops absorb in 1 minute and makeup glides.

Body & stretch marks — apply to damp skin after shower for a daily glow. For stretch marks and belly, mix 1 tablespoon Baobab + 1 teaspoon Rosehip + 1 tablespoon Shea Butter and massage into belly, thighs, butt and breasts in circular motions for 3 minutes, twice daily (start in month 3 of pregnancy).
Cracked heels & hands — apply a thick layer at night and wear socks.
Hair (best light oil for 4C) — use 4-5 drops daily, smoothed onto the ends; it won't make hair white or heavy.
Scalp massage for growth — 1 tablespoon Baobab + 1 teaspoon Castor Oil + 3 drops Rosemary Essential Oil; massage the scalp for 5 minutes, 3x a week.
Softening & detangling — mix 1 tablespoon of baobab oil with water in a spray bottle and spritz on hair before combing.
Hot oil treatment — warm slightly, apply root to tip, cover with a cap for 1 hour, then shampoo out to restore shine.
Beard oil — 3 drops daily into the beard. For baby — warm a tiny amount between palms and massage gently; avoid the eyes.
No need to dilute — safe to use pure. Do not heat to high temperatures — it destroys the vitamins.
products.caution: Extremely safe — one of the gentlest oils; safe for sensitive skin, pregnant women and babies (patch test for baby first). Non-comedogenic — won't clog pores. For external use only. Storage: keeps 2 years — store in a cool, dark place with the lid tight; the golden colour may vary slightly by harvest, which is natural. If it smells rancid, discard. How to spot real cold-pressed baobab: real oil is golden yellow, light, with a nutty earthy smell, absorbs in seconds, and is labelled Adansonia digitata — cold-pressed, virgin, unrefined, from seeds (not pulp). Fake oil is clear, odorless and watery, or very dark brown and greasy — refined or old. Note: oil pressed from the fruit pulp is different — the seed oil is more powerful for skin and hair.
